"""In Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML), the pathognomonic $t(9;22)$ translocation creates the constitutively active BCR-ABL1 chimeric tyrosine kinase, which drives aberrant granulocyte proliferation via continuous autophosphorylation and downstream signaling. 3. If the explanation is an explicit abstention stating that no evidence exists (e.g. for negative controls), classify the abstention claim as "SUPPORTED".

[
  {
    "claim": "Atomic factual statement",
    "verdict": "SUPPORTED" | "HALLUCINATED" | "CONTRADICTED",

  }
]
